videos.overview: Professor Simon gives Emma a fun science lesson using a glass of OJ! The Wiggles and their friends make some funny fruit hats and do 'The Mango Walk', showing that fruit can be fun as well as being yummy and healthy!

videos.title: Emma's Missing Bow
videos.overview: Emma can't find her favourite bow! The Wiggles call the famous French detective Dr Siméon to help solve the mystery. Even with a big mystery to solve, The Wiggles still have time to sing and dance to some of their favourite songs!

videos.title: We Like Fruit
videos.overview: Emma uses strawberries to learn about counting, and The Wiggles sing, songs about their favourite healthy snacks!

videos.title: Is That Lachy?
videos.overview: Emma has a brand new alarm clock to give to one of her friends, but who is it for? Have fun putting the clues together and try to guess who Emma's present is for!

videos.title: Hula Hoop Symphony
videos.overview: The Wiggles have so much fun playing with their hula hoops that they decide to form a hula hoop symphony! Captain Feathersword and Emma make a poem about Goats and their hairy throats.

videos.title: Clean Your Teeth
videos.overview: Before The Wiggles leave for a big show they remember that they have to take care of their teeth! The Wiggles invite their friend Dennis the Dentist over to learn about brushing and taking care of their teeth.

videos.title: Percussion Party
videos.overview: There is always something fun to do at The Wiggles' house! Emma and Captain Feathersword are making up poems while playing dress-ups and trying on cowboy hats, and The Wiggles recite some of their favourite nursery rhymes.

videos.title: Marty Party
videos.overview: Today is a special day in Wiggle House because it is Anthony's birthday! The Wiggles are throwing a huge party to celebrate Anthony's special day, but they need help to make it the best birthday party ever! The world's greatest party planner, Dr Marty Party.

videos.title: Is It Captain Feathersword?
videos.overview: Anthony has a crazy new dance which he wants to try out with one of his wiggly friends! Using Anthony's clues, have fun trying to work out who the mystery friend is!

videos.title: Is That Wags?
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword has cooked a treat for one of his friends, but he wants you to try and guess who! Use the clues and see if you can solve the mystery! Join The Wiggles as they sing a traditional Eskimo song.

videos.title: Harry Hula
videos.overview: The Wiggles love playing with hula hoops and seeing who can keep their hoop spinning the longest, but their friend Captain Feathersword doesn't know how to hula!

videos.title: Musical Memory
videos.overview: There are lots of musical activities to do in The Wiggles' house! Join Captain Feathersword and Professor Simon while they play with musical instruments and learn the different sounds that different instruments make!

videos.title: Doctor Entertainment
videos.overview: Emma, Lachy and Simon are taking turns reading to each other from their favourite storybook, but Lachy's reading is so boring that he soon puts everyone to sleep!

videos.title: Singing with Lachy
videos.overview: Lachy loves to sing, and he wants you to join in with him! From high notes to low notes, Lachy's singing lessons will help you sing better than you've ever sung before!

videos.title: Quack, Quack!
videos.overview: When The Wiggles find some old Broadway canes they decide to perform a Broadway style musical number in their own lounge room! With jazzy singing and tap dancing, it's like a musical trip back in time!

videos.title: Slow Motion Anthony
videos.overview: Disaster in Wiggle House as Anthony is magically reduced to doing everything in slow motion! If he stays in slow motion, he won't be able to keep up with The Wiggles and their friends having fun!

videos.title: Lounge Room Symphony
videos.overview: Do you want to make music but don't have any musical instruments to play with? Don't worry, The Wiggly Lounge Room Symphony will show you how you can use your hands, feet, voice and things around the house as instruments!

videos.title: Wiggly Yoga
videos.overview: The Wiggles are always trying new ways to keep healthy and strong, and today Anthony is trying out the ancient art of yoga!

videos.title: A Musical Cake
videos.overview: Master chef Murray the Cook has discovered a way to make cakes even more delicious by adding a secret ingredient; music! Murray the Cook travels to Wiggle House to join The Wiggles in baking the tastiest and most musical cake that has ever been made! Bon appétit!

videos.title: The Glass is Half Full
videos.overview: Professor Simon is back to teach The Wiggles about science and maths using everyday objects in Wiggle House. Today's lesson uses a glass of tasty milk to learn about volume, and whether the glass is full, half-full, or empty.

videos.title: Super-Speed Simon Says
videos.overview: Simon always loves to play his favourite game, 'Simon Says'. While playing his favourite game with Lachy and Emma, Simon loses control and begins playing 'Simon Says' at super speed!

videos.title: Sign the ABC
videos.overview: The Wiggles want everyone to be able to join in and have fun in Wiggle House, for the boys and girls who have trouble hearing or communicating in Australia there is Auslan, a special way of talking with hands and gestures.

videos.title: Joannie Works with One Hammer
videos.overview: You can have lots of fun using your imagination, like with the song 'Joannie Works With One Hammer' where you imagine that your hands, feet and your head are pretend hammers as you jump around and hammer away at the air!

videos.title: Doctor Anglais
videos.overview: During one of his many magical adventures, Anthony seems to have been transported back in time and now dresses and speaks like people did hundreds of years ago!

videos.title: Is That Simon?
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword has a brand new hula hoop to give to one of his friends in Wiggle House, but who is it for? Use the captain's clues to work out who in Wiggle house is getting a hula hoop.

videos.title: Professor Simon's Musical Challenge
videos.overview: The Wiggles are visited by a friend from Saudi Arabia, and learn how to sing 'Rock-a-Bye Your Bear' in Arabic! Simon gives Dorothy the Dinosaur a singing lesson!

videos.title: Captain's Experiment
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword is learning about science from Professor Simon, who once again shows how the kitchen can become your very own science lab! Emma is teaching a lesson in ballet, a beautiful type of dancing!

videos.title: Doctor Treble Clef
videos.overview: Simon is one of the most talented singers in the Wiggly world, but his cowbell playing could use some improvement! The Wiggles decide to call the musical genius Doctor Treble Clef to see if he can help Simon.

videos.title: Captain and the Tomatoes
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword and Professor Simon are in The Wiggles' kitchen learning about numerals and addition using some delicious and healthy tomatoes!

videos.title: A Juicy Story
videos.overview: Professor Simon is back in the kitchen teaching his Wiggly friends about science and maths! His first lesson is with Lachy, showing how you can wiggle and learn even if you're just enjoying a glass of apple juice!

videos.title: Captain's Lost Hornpipe
videos.overview: It's National Hornpipe Day and Captain Feathersword is so excited to teach The Wiggles his famous hornpipe! Sadly, Captain's hornpipe is broken! The Wiggles call Hilary Hornpipe for help.

videos.title: Emma's Ballet
videos.overview: Emma dresses up as a ballerina for a Wiggly guessing game. Will The Wiggles guess what she is dressed up as or is it "tutu" hard? We do some "bow-tiful" ballet with 'Emma's Bow Minuet'.

videos.title: Apples and Bananas
videos.overview: Dorothy the Dinosaur has a chat to her friends and asks them all about pets and we get to play with some puppy dogs! We sing and dance along to 'Apples & Bananas', and even join The Wiggles live on stage to sing 'Hot Potato'.

videos.title: Emma's Bike Won't Work
videos.overview: Emma gets ready to ride her bike but it won't work! The Wiggles call Willy Fixit for some help. We say hello to 'Little Sir Echo' then it's time for some animal fun as we learn about a 'Talking Cow'!

videos.title: Dressing Up in Style
videos.overview: Emma teaches some "bow-tiful" ballet in her pointe shoes. We scat along with Lachy as we 'Do the Skeleton Scat!' then it's off to The Wiggles' show to dance along to 'Romp Bomp a Stomp' live in concert. It's "stomptastic"!

videos.title: Lachy Can't Rhyme
videos.overview: Lachy is trying to write a rhyming poem with the word 'cat' but is having some trouble. He brings back William Shakespeare to help him. We learn all about the letter 'F' in 'Simon's Alphabet'.

videos.title: Simon's Brush with Fame
videos.overview: Simon dresses up as a painter for a wiggly guessing game. We can listen to the clues and help The Wiggles guess what Simon is dressed as. We learn about gloriously, great, guitars in 'Simon's Alphabet', then head to the zoo.

videos.title: Big Red Boat
videos.overview: Put your life jackets on and lets go sailing as we sing along to 'Big Red Boat'. Emma teaches us some Irish dancing then we all Irish dance together to 'I'll Tell Me Ma'. And Simon sings a duet with Zamel the Camel.

videos.title: Anthony Forgets
videos.overview: Anthony is in charge of doing the wiggly grocery shopping but he has become a bit forgetful. The Wiggles call Mary and Michael Memory for some help. We do some "bow-tifiul" ballet with Emma as she sings 'Fa la Ninna'.

videos.title: Do the Hawk
videos.overview: We sing and dance along to 'Do the Hawk' with Lee Hawkins! Dorothy the Dinosaur talks to her friends about painting and we do some arts and crafts together. We learn all about juicy, jiggly, jellyfish in 'Simon's Alphabet'.

videos.title: Simon Can't Stop Yodelling
videos.overview: Simon smells a special yodeling flower and can't stop yodelling! The Wiggles call Dr Heidi Von Trappington for help. The yodeling continues as we sing along to 'Simon's Cold Water Blues'.

videos.title: Cowboy Anthony
videos.overview: Anthony dresses up as a cowboy for a wiggly guessing game. We use the clues to help The Wiggles guess what Anthony is dressed up as.

videos.title: Simon's Sad Fruit Salad
videos.overview: Simon's singing is making him feel too sad to eat his fruit salad! The Wiggles call Jonathon Joyful and Cindy Serenity to help Simon feel better.

videos.title: The Talking Cow
videos.overview: It's off to The Wiggles show to sing and dance along to 'Can You (Point Your Fingers and Do the Twist?)' live in concert!

videos.title: Beaky Can't Sing
videos.overview: Lachy tries to sing an Italian duet with his bird Beaky but Beaky can't sing! The Wiggles call Bertie Birdman for help.

videos.title: Little Sir Echo
videos.overview: Dorothy the Dinosaur talks to her friends all about instruments and we watch a band playing their instruments!

videos.title: Ahoy There, Lachy
videos.overview: Lachy is dressing up as a sailor for a wiggly guessing game! We use the clues to help The Wiggles guess what Lachy is dressed as.

videos.title: Emma's Reading Challenge
videos.overview: Emma tries to read a book but can't see anything! The Wiggles call Dr Spectacle to help Emma see again. We all sing along to 'I've Got My Glasses On'. We can see clearly now!

videos.title: This Little Piggy
videos.overview: Emma teaches us some jazz dancing and we sing along to 'This Little Piggy Went to Market' with special guest Lee Hawkins!

videos.title: Beep! Beep! Buckle Up!
videos.overview: Dorothy the Dinosaur talks to her friends about driving in the car and we learn all about car safety as we sing along to 'Beep! Beep! Buckle Up!'

videos.title: Anthony's Singing
videos.overview: Anthony keeps singing too loudly! The Wiggles call volume control specialists Counselor Country, Senator Soul and Lady Rock and Roll to help Anthony get his voice back to normal.

videos.title: King Simon
videos.overview: Simon dresses up as a king for a wiggly guessing game. We use the clues to help The Wiggles guess what Simon is dressed as.

videos.title: Wiggle Talk
videos.overview: Simon is only speaking in Wiggle words! The Wiggles call Dr Rock for some help.

videos.title: Wiggly Picnic
videos.overview: We have a wiggly ballet lesson with Emma and dance the ballet to 'Fa La Ninna'. Then it's time for some alphabet fun with Professor Simon!

videos.title: Beaky Overeats
videos.overview: The Wiggles have accidentally overfed their bird, Beaky! They call Dr Gallah for some help. We flap our wings and dance along to 'Feeling Chirpy'.

videos.title: Zamel the Camel
videos.overview: It's off to The Wiggles show to dance along to 'Toot Toot, Chugga Chugga, Big Red Car' live in concert!

videos.title: Wags Lost His Wiggle
videos.overview: We discover that Wags has lost his wiggle! The Wiggles call Dr Antonio, Maria and Lucia to help Wags.

videos.title: Miss Lucy Had a Ducky
videos.overview: We have a tap dancing lesson with Emma. We learn how to do a shuffle!

videos.title: A Mariachi Moment
videos.overview: Anthony has dressed up as a Mariachi musician for a wiggly guessing game! I wonder if the other Wiggles will guess what Anthony is dressed as. We sing a spooky song about 'Mumbles the Monster'.

videos.title: Riding in the Big Red Car
videos.overview: We go 'Dancing on the High Seas' with Captain Feathersword!

videos.title: The Laughing Doctor
videos.overview: Simon has trouble singing the high notes so The Wiggles call Dr. High-Low to help Simon out!

videos.title: Irish Dancing!
videos.overview: Dorothy has a chat to her friends all about safe swimming then it's off to the pools. We find out 'Who's in the Wiggle House' then The Wiggles sing 'Hot Potato' with special guest, Lou Diamond Phillips.

videos.title: Emma the Firefighter
videos.overview: Emma is dressing as a firefighter for a wiggly guessing game. Can The Wiggles guess what she is dressed as using the clues? We learn about glorious, great guitars in 'Simon's Alphabet' then it's time for a musical treat.

videos.title: Lachy's Orange Hair
videos.overview: Lachy's hair turns orange so The Wiggles call Professor Perm for help! Can she return Lachy's hair to it's former glory? We learn about the letter 'H' with Professor Simon then it's time to get jumping as we sing and dance.

videos.title: Romp Bomp a Stomp
videos.overview: Simon sings an operatic duet with Zamel the Camel! Then it's time to relax as we sing 'Koala-By' with some sleeping koalas. We have some literacy fun with Professor Simon then it's time to watch The Wiggles perform.

videos.title: What's Your Favourite Nursery Rhyme?
videos.overview: We dance some beautiful ballet with Emma, Wags and the wiggly ballerinas. Simon asks us "what's your favourite nursery rhyme?" and we do all the actions to 'The Wheels on the Bus'.

videos.title: Detective Lachy
videos.overview: Lachy is dressing up for a wiggly guessing game! I wonder if The Wiggles can guess what he is dressed as by using the clues. We sail along the ocean blue in the 'Big Red Boat' then groove along to 'Hey, Wags!'

videos.title: Emma's Bad Hair Day
videos.overview: The wind has blown Emma's hair everywhere! They call Dr Hairy and his sister Harriet to help fix Emma's hair problem. We learn all about the letter 'L' in 'Simon's Alphabet'.

videos.title: Lachy Can't Sing!
videos.overview: Lachy has lost his voice! The Wiggles call Dr Phillipa Frog for help. Will Lachy get his voice back in time for The Wiggles' town concert? We dance some beautiful ballet with Emma as she sings 'Sur le Pont D' Avignon'.

videos.title: Say the Dance, Do the Dance
videos.overview: Emma teaches us how to do some ballet in a Wiggly dance lesson. It's so "bow-tiful"! The dancing continues as we sing and dance along to 'Say the Dance, Do the Dance'. We practice our literacy with Professor Simon.

videos.title: Missing Bow
videos.overview: Emma has lost her bow! The Wiggles call bow detectives Lucia, Maria and Antonio, as well as Chief Inspector Hawk. Will they be able to find Emma's bow? Professor Simon teaches us about the letter 'O' then we sing and dance.

videos.title: Captain's Magic Buttons
videos.overview: Anthony is all dressed up for a wiggly guessing game! Will The Wiggles guess what Anthony is dressed as by using the clues? Things get spooky as we sing and dance along to 'Skeleton Scat'.

videos.title: Simon the Opera Singer
videos.overview: Simon is dressed up as an opera singer for a wiggly guessing game! I wonder if The Wiggles can guess what Simon is dressed up as. We learn about the letter 'Q' in 'Simon's Alphabet' and groove along to 'Pappadum'.

videos.title: Dorothy's Baking
videos.overview: Dorothy the Dinosaur chats to her friends all about their favourite foods then we bake a cake together in the kitchen! We watch the wheels go round and round in 'Jack's Wheelchair Song'.

videos.title: Lachy's Bunny Caller
videos.overview: Lachy has trouble calling a bunny and ends up with Mr Funny and Sunny! Will Lachy be able to find some bunnies? We bounce along to the 'Bunny Hop' and take a drive and sing along to 'In the Big Red Car We Like to Ride'.

videos.title: Food, Train & Animals
videos.overview: Dorothy the Dinosaur has a chat to her friends all about healthy food, and then we head to the kitchen to make a sandwich! We learn all about the letter 'T' in 'Simon's Alphabet' and sing 'Wobbly Camel' in The Wiggles' house!

videos.title: Princess Emma of Wigglehouse
videos.overview: Emma dresses up as a princess for a wiggly guessing game! Will The Wiggles guess what Emma is dressed up as? We dance along to 'Emma's Bow Minuet', and learn about all the treasures Emma keeps in her room.

videos.title: Anthony Has Overeaten
videos.overview: Anthony has eaten too much food and isn't feeling too good! The Wiggles call Phil Fitness to help Anthony out. Will Phil be able to help Anthony feel better?

videos.title: Hip Hop with Emma
videos.overview: We have a wiggly dance lesson with Emma and learn how to do some hip hop! We 'Do the Hawk' with special guest Lee Hawkins and do the actions to 'Pufferbillies'. We learn all about the letter 'W' in 'Simon's Alphabet'.

videos.title: Lachy's Bird Poem
videos.overview: Lachy is having trouble finding rhyming words for his poetry! Lachy calls Beaky the Galah to help him out. Will Lachy be able to finish his poem? We move our arms just like a birdy and dance along to 'Feeling Chirpy'.

videos.title: I'll Tell Me Ma
videos.overview: Anthony dresses up in style for a wiggly guessing game! I wonder if The Wiggles will guess what Anthony is dressed up as. We do some Irish dancing to 'I'll Tell Me Ma' with Emma and the wiggly Irish dancers.

videos.title: Lachy's Pappadum Party
videos.overview: Lachy is having trouble with his most recent invention! Dr Good-Food comes to the rescue to help Lachy out. We do the actions to 'The Wheels on the Bus' and sing and dance along to 'Pappadum'.

videos.title: Hello, Everyone!
videos.overview: Hello, everyone! Let's say 'g'day' to The Wiggles & learn a little bit about them. Come with us on a trip to Wiggle Park to dance with Henry the Octopus, play piano with Lachy & travel back in time to meet the Little Wiggles!

videos.title: Bow Mobile to the Rescue!
videos.overview: The Wiggles love to go driving in the Big Red Car and today Captain Feathersword wants to join them. There are only four seats and five people that need to fit! What will The Wiggles do?

videos.title: Wiggly Radio
videos.overview: Who listens to the radio? The Wiggles do! The Wiggles discover that different types of music can make you feel different things while listening to the radio over breakfast. It can relax you or inspire you to dance!

videos.title: No Fleas Please!
videos.overview: Wags the Dog seems to be doing a very strange scritchy, scratchy dance without any music. This could only mean one thing... fleas! The Wiggles are going to need the help of a special vet to help their friend Wags feel better.

videos.title: The Wiggly Races
videos.overview: It's time for a wiggly running race with Emma, Lachy, Simon and Anthony competing for first place. It reminds Simon of some animal friends, so it's a trip to the Carnival of the Animals to meet a very slow tortoise.

videos.title: The Singing Barbers
videos.overview: After going for a "bowtiful" bike ride, Emma discovers her hair is a disaster! Her bike helmet has disrupted her do! How will she get her signature style back? There is only one solution... The Singing Barbers of Wiggle Town!

videos.title: A  Wiggly Wedding
videos.overview: The Wiggles love to dress up in style and today is no exception! The Wiggles and their friends are having a pretend wiggly wedding with Dorothy the Dinosaur as the pretend bride and Wags the Dog as the pretend groom.

videos.title: Dancing Is So Much Fun
videos.overview: There are so many different styles of dance and The Wiggles love them all! Join Emma and the Scottish dancers as they bow to the King and do the Highland Fling.

videos.title: Numerals Are Nice
videos.overview: The Wiggles love driving in the Big Red Car but sometimes it can be tricky to figure out who should get in the car first! Emma comes up with a special game using numerals to help The Wiggles and it's so much fun!

videos.title: Yummy In My Tummy
videos.overview: Did you know Lachy Wiggle is a wonderful cook? Today he is cooking up a storm at Wiggle House, making some delicious fish. It reminds him of Newfoundland, so it's off to the Squid Jiggin' Ground for a song and dance!

videos.title: Waltzing Matilda
videos.overview: 'Waltzing Matilda' is a wonderful song and an Australian favourite! The Wiggles enjoy playing the song on a variety of instruments and discover the song has musical similarities to other songs!

videos.title: Rock & Roll Preschool
videos.overview: The Wiggles take a trip down memory lane and share some of their favourite memories of their time at preschool but with a musical twist! It turns out Anthony went to a Rock & Roll Preschool!

videos.title: Hot Potato
videos.overview: A healthy and hearty breakfast is a great way to start the day! With a great breakfast as their fuel, there is plenty of dancing in Wiggle World today. There are dancing elves, Irish dancing, singing barbers and more.

videos.title: The Wiggly Opera
videos.overview: Simon Wiggle is a fantastic opera singer. It is his favourite style! He wants to give the other Wiggles an "opera-tunity" to sing in his favourite style and provides them with a special wardrobe item that helps them sing!

videos.title: Clap Your Hands
videos.overview: If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands! There are so many things that make The Wiggles happy. Dancing makes Emma and Lachy very happy, so they pas de deux dance with Dorothy the Dinosaur.

videos.title: Feather Fun!
videos.overview: Who is the resident feather expert in Wiggle Town? It's The Wiggles' friend Captain Feathersword, of course! The Wiggles find feathers that match their Wiggle colours and do a fabulous, fantastic, feather dance!

videos.title: Fly Through the Sky
videos.overview: It's time to explore flying! Anthony's beautiful banjo doesn't fit in the Big Red Car so Anthony has to fly the Wiggly Plane to their show. Luckily he has his pilot's licence!

videos.title: Pigtail Polka
videos.overview: Today is 'Pigtail Polka' day in Wiggle Town! Emma needs some help getting her hair 'Pigtail Polka' ready but her fellow Wiggles don't know how to braid. A trip to the Singing Barbers of Wiggle Town is just what Emma needs.

videos.title: Soccer Fun
videos.overview: The Wiggles have so many different interests and passions! Did you know Lachy loves soccer? A soccer game in Wiggle Town is just the ticket! Did you know that Emma is interested in meteorology? And Simon loves animals!

videos.title: Dance with Emma
videos.overview: Emma Wiggle is the dancing queen of Wiggle Town! She loves to dance wherever she goes inspiring the people of Wiggle Town to join. Whether it's hip-hop with Captain Feathersword, or an underwater dance with Henry the Octopus.

videos.title: Enthusiasm!
videos.overview: The Wiggles love fruit salad. It's yummy, yummy! Today in Wiggle Town, each Wiggle picks their favourite fruit to go into a freshly made fruit smoothie.

videos.title: Simon Says
videos.overview: The Wiggles have performed so many wiggly concerts over the years but it doesn't mean they don't get nervous before a show! Simon is a little bit worried about his solo in a musical version of his favourite game, Simon Says.

videos.title: Henry Saves the Day
videos.overview: The Wiggles always start their day with a nutritious breakfast to ensure they have enough energy for the day. It seems they've eaten a little late today and have no time to wash up. Who better to call than Henry the Octopus?

videos.title: Dorothy's Tea Party
videos.overview: Dorothy the Dinosaur is coming to Wiggle House for a tea party! Lachy Wiggle makes the preparations and takes the wiggly tea orders of all the guests. Dorothy loves eating roses so rosy tea is at the top of the list!

videos.title: The Wiggly Plane
videos.overview: The Wiggles have to take a lot of costumes and instruments with them in the Big Red Car to put on a Wiggles show. It seems the Big Red Car won't start because it's too full! How will The Wiggles get to their show on time?

videos.title: Do The Twist!
videos.overview: Let's go back in time to when The Wiggles were younger! They have always loved to sing and dance. Today they are pointing their fingers and doing the twist. Can you point your fingers and do the twist?

videos.title: Five Fingered Family
videos.overview: What's happening in The Wiggles World today? It's rainy outside today, what could The Wiggles do? Then it's off to Curly Town, Lachy has been invited to a tea party.

videos.title: Avo, Avo, Avocado!
videos.overview: James and Paul the dancing waiter serve up Smashed Avocado, Emma's favourite. Can you do the smashed avocado dance? Wags the dog plays a trick on Paul and he ends up with custard pie cream all over his face. Oh Wags!

videos.title: We've Got Our Glasses On
videos.overview: It's time to look inside Emmas Weather Bag, she finds a hat and sunglasses. It's going to be a sunny day today. Join the Wiggles as they sing and dance to the Canadian Alphabet, celebrating everything Canadian.

videos.title: Cowboy Fun
videos.overview: Today's special is Cowboy Chilli! Anthony and Wags learn how to eat the cowboy way. Then it's off to Wiggly Arena with Lachy and Ponso The Pony. Let's go riding with Ponso the Pony, Yippee-aye-aye!

videos.title: Shirley Shawn The Unicorn
videos.overview: Emma has always loved to tap dance. Join Emma as she reminiscences learning to tap with the help of The little Wiggles. It's time to 'Look Both Ways' with The Cartoon Wiggles, as road safety is such an important issue.

videos.title: We're All Friends
videos.overview: Lachy's inventions never seem to work as planned! Join in with Music with Anthony and enjoy some beautiful ballet and highland dancing! Join our curly haired friend Lachy, in Curly World because we're all friends.

videos.title: Stinky Cheese Day!
videos.overview: Join Simon and The Wiggles live at the Wiggly Arena for a game of Simon Says. Then it is off to Le James Cafe, what's that strong smell? It's stinky cheese day at Le James Cafe, pong appetite!

videos.title: Lachy's Curly World
videos.overview: Join The Wiggles and Captain Feathersword as they have a little party. King Sam and Lachy are joined by self-professed "first hijab ballerina" Stephanie as she dances some beautiful ballet.

videos.title: A King Who Liked To Sing!
videos.overview: Lachy dances and prances and becomes a King in Curly World today - you can be Royal too! In Story Time with Simon and his friend Shirley Shawn The Unicorn, we meet Terry the strutting turkey, 'wibble wobble, gobble, gobble!'

videos.title: Surfer Bop
videos.overview: What's happening in The Wiggles World today? Paul the dancing waiter serves up 'Surf and Turf' to Anthony and Wags at Le James Cafe. Everyone grooves to the Surfer Bop, let's all dance to the 'Surfer Bop'!

videos.title: Emma's Weather Bag
videos.overview: What is happening in Wiggles World Today? It's a blow me down weather day, Emma goes into her weather bag and finds a jacket, scarf and lip balm for her drive in the Bow Mobile to the Wiggle House.

videos.title: Sticky Rice Cake Surprise
videos.overview: It's time to guess the secret dish that will be served at Le James Cafe, what could it be? It's of the colour orange and has seeds you can scoop out.

videos.title: Broccoli Brunch
videos.overview: Join Captain Feathersword and do the 'Captain's Wobbly Dance!' James the owner of Le James Cafe has Broccoli on the menu today! Dance along to the 'Broccoli Bunch' as we eat these delicious and healthy vegetables!

videos.title: A Puppet Show!
videos.overview: Anthony loves the sound of the electric guitar and plays a number of songs for us to enjoy. The King of Curly Town would like Lachy to do a puppet show. We meet Spot the Dalmatian, Zorich the Zebra and Phil the Platypus.

videos.title: Funny Face
videos.overview: Simon dresses up as Gregory Griggs, who has 47 different wigs. Lachy shows us how to make a funny face in Curly World. It's Scotch Eggs day at Le James Cafe, The Wiggles sing a song about this delicious treat.

videos.title: Put The Pop In The Popcorn
videos.overview: Emma's Cat 'Banjo' likes lots of cuddles. It's Party Day at Le James Cafe, so James is serving party food to put us in the party mood. Wags the Dog plays a trick on Paul and ends up with fruit salad and yogurt on his face.

videos.title: Double Talk With The Captain
videos.overview: With one little spray of Lachy's lavender mist people learn to speak with a twist! We meet Willy the wobbly worm during Story Time with Simon and Shirley Shawn The Unicorn.

videos.title: Hot Dog
videos.overview: The Wiggles have fun building with blocks. Anthony places the last piece and it tumbles down! Paul the dancing waiter serves up vegan hot dogs at Le James Cafe. Hot Vegan Diggity Dog!

videos.title: Cream Pie Fun
videos.overview: Emma looks inside her weather bag and finds lots of thing to keep her dry on a rainy day. Anthony makes a delicious pie and remembers when he was a Little Wiggle and Simon and Lachy ended up with pie cream on their faces.

videos.title: It's Sunny Today
videos.overview: Simon helps us in choosing what to wear for different weather. James the dancing waiter serves up pretzels at Le James Cafe and we can all join in doing 'The Pretzel'.

videos.title: The Curly Bird
videos.overview: It's International Dance Like an Octopus Day! Henry the Octopus is here to show us how to dance. Let's clap our hands above our heads and sway from side to side. King Sam needs Lachy's help cheering up a yellow bird in town.

videos.title: Dance Spectacular!
videos.overview: Anthony has forgotten how to laugh! Lachy, Simon and Emma can't make Anthony laugh so they call on The Laughing doctor for help. Join Emma, Lachy and lots of their Wiggly Friends for a wiggletastic dance spectacular!

videos.title: Sensational Salsa
videos.overview: Meet Anthony's dog Fergus, and we can all 'Scrubby, Dub, Dub' and wash our pets. Paul the dancing waiter is serving Chunky Salsa today at Le James Cafe. It's time to dance the Salsa to this musical dish.

videos.title: Little, Little, Little Ford Fauntleroy
videos.overview: The Wiggles are joined by Little, Little, Little Lord Fauntleroy. Anthony plays the director and fun ensues. The Cartoon Wiggles are here in an all new animated music video, 'Shirley Shawn The Unicorn'.

videos.title: Dorothy's Rosy Tea Time
videos.overview: The Wiggles are having a rosy tea party with Dorothy the Dinosaur. Le James cafe is serving Irish Stew, it's Anthony's favourite thing to eat. Let's join hands and do the dance from Ireland, The Irish Stew.

videos.title: World Record Dancing
videos.overview: Paul the dancing waiter is serving up turkey at Le James Cafe. Flap your wings and scratch with the Turkey Dance. The Wiggles keep dancing to set a world record with the help of The Little Wiggles.

videos.title: The Transportation Parade
videos.overview: Everyone in town is getting ready to drive in the Annual Transportation Parade, and Captain Feathersword has treasures to give each of the Wiggles.

videos.title: Exercising with Our Friends
videos.overview: Bok and Anthony get a special lesson from a fitness instructor before the Wiggles and their friends practice their favorite exercise moves together.

videos.title: Teamwork in Wiggle Town
videos.overview: Bok practices juggling with Jeff. The Wiggles are busy preparing for a pirate ship picnic aboard the SS Feathersword and a visit to Wiggle Bay.

videos.title: I Can See You, You Can See Me
videos.overview: Emma, Bok and Samuel get to know their reflections and draw self-portraits. Dorothy, Henry and Wags join the Wiggles for more visual activities.

videos.title: Wash Your Hands
videos.overview: Anthony can't wait to eat one of the delicious scones Lachy has been baking, but he'll need to make sure his hands are clean before he can have one!

videos.title: Brr It's Cold Outside
videos.overview: Bok and the Wiggles get bundled up to keep warm on a cold day. When they hear someone's teeth chattering, they set off to find out how they can help.

videos.title: We’re All Fruit Salad
videos.overview: If the Wiggles want to make a fruit salad, they're going to need some fruit. Anthony goes in search of friends who can help fill up their bowl.

videos.title: Captain’s Birthday Party
videos.overview: Bok, Lachy and Jeff play the name game. Captain Feathersword is throwing a party to celebrate his birthday! But where could all the Wiggles be?

videos.title: The Instruments We Love to Play
videos.overview: New friend Victor sings a song with Bok, Emma and Anthony. Everyone in Wiggle Town gets out their musical instruments to play in a jam session.

videos.title: How Are You Feeling Today?
videos.overview: Samuel, Bok and Emma talk about and draw their feelings. When Lachy breaks the vase he's been making, Captain Feathersword comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Emma's Missing Glasses
videos.overview: It's story time! The Wiggles help Emma remember where she left her glasses, which she needs to read a book, before practicing a new dance with Henry.

videos.title: Rainbow of Colours
videos.overview: Emma decides to draw a rainbow, since she can't find one in the sky. She'll need colored pencils, so she asks all her wiggly friends for help.

videos.title: The Foods We Love to Eat
videos.overview: Elisabetta helps Bok feed the fish. The Wiggles were so busy they forgot to eat and got very hungry! Now it's time to make some healthy snacks.

videos.title: Old McDonald Had a Farm
videos.overview: It's a special day in Wiggle Town, and everyone's dressing up as their favorite animal. Tsehay and John search for the owner of a cow hat they find.

videos.title: A Sailor Went to Sea
videos.overview: While looking for snacks to bring to the beach, Simon and Caterina find a pretty seashell. Who could it belong to?

videos.title: Pufferbillies
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword and Lachy find a train ticket and wonder how to use it. "Pufferbillies" is the song of the day.

videos.title: This Little Piggy Went To Market
videos.overview: Anthony and Lucia try to figure out what to do with an empty water bottle. Get your fingers moving when the Wiggles sing "This Little Piggy."

videos.title: The Alphabet Song
videos.overview: Guess what Simon and Evie find in the Wiggly Kitchen today? Keep your eyes peeled! Sing along and learn the ABCs with "The Alphabet Song."

videos.title: I Like to Eat Apples and Bananas
videos.overview: Tsehay and John are in the Wiggly Kitchen looking for a snack to have after they exercise. Lucky for them, they find an apple and a banana!

videos.title: Joannie Works With Five Hammers
videos.overview: What will Anthony and Simon find in the Wiggly Kitchen today? Hint: It's something heavy that you can build things with!

videos.title: Incy Wincy Spider
videos.overview: Caterina and John want to find out who left a beautiful red rose in the Wiggly Kitchen. Rainy weather outside calls for singing the "Incy Wincy Spider."

videos.title: Five Little Ducks
videos.overview: Lachy and Lucia are making animal shapes with items in the Wiggly Kitchen when they find a red balloon. Where did it come from?

videos.title: This Old Man
videos.overview: Evie, Anthony and Paloma the Mermaid search the Wiggly Kitchen for something to feed Wags the Dog. Later, they get help from the Dancing Water Police.

videos.title: Rock-a-Bye Your Bear
videos.overview: Tsehay and Henry the Octopus are practicing salsa dance moves when they discover a painting of a blue teddy bear. Who made it?

videos.title: Wabash Cannonball
videos.overview: In the Wiggly Kitchen, Simon and Wags the Dog see a red helmet and wonder who owns it. Riding on a train, the Wiggles sing "Wabash Cannonball."

videos.title: If You're Happy and You Know It
videos.overview: John and Lachy find a yellow flower and want to know what kind it is. Today's song is "If You're Happy and You Know It."
